item.title: Master Your Webinar Release Verification Static Publishing Workflow!
item.description:
I still remember the nerves before my very first webinar launch using a static site workflow — the clock was ticking, the team buzzing, and me thinking, “I’ve got this.” Then bam! Halfway through the live event, a flood of messages: “The video won’t play!” “Slides are missing!” “Links are broken!” That sinking feeling? It wasn’t just embarrassment. It was the gut punch of realizing I had no solid way to catch these problems before hitting publish.
